description: fact is whispered to the asking player inside the private clue; confirm is the contact's spoken payoff at the destination. kinds restricts by hook kind.

entries.fact: Someone I trust sold word of this errand. I do not know who.
entries.confirm: So there was a leak. I will find out who talks.

entries.fact: {stake.short|cap} is worth far more than anyone admits, and that is why it is hunted.
entries.confirm: It is worth far more than coin. You were right to hurry.

entries.fact: Whatever happens, do not open {stake.short}. It is meant for one pair of hands only.
entries.confirm: Still unopened. Good. That is what keeps it whole.

entries.fact: At the door, say that the lamps are low. {contact.first} will know you are friends.
entries.confirm: You knew the words about the lamps. Then {patron.first} trusts you.

entries.fact: {contact.first} owes me an old kindness, so ask {contact.obj} plainly for help.
entries.confirm: Yes, I owe {patron.first} an old kindness. Consider it paid.

entries.fact: Whoever hired the ones chasing us wears a ring with a green stone. Watch for it.
entries.confirm: A green stone? Then I know exactly who is behind this.

entries.fact: There is a quicker way to the end of the road, through a gap most travelers miss.
entries.confirm: Yes, the quick way is real. Keep it to yourselves.

entries.fact: This is partly my fault. I left something unguarded, and I am ashamed.
entries.confirm: Do not blame {patron.first}. What matters is that you came.

entries.fact: It all ends at moonset. After that, what we carry will be worthless.
entries.confirm: You were in time. Moonset would have been too late.

entries.fact: I let the town believe a different destination, on purpose. Only you and {contact.first} know the truth.
entries.confirm: The false trail worked. They are watching the wrong door.

entries.fact: A friend watches from the dark, and will step in only if all seems lost.
entries.confirm: You were never alone out there. I sent a friend to watch.

entries.fact: {stake.short|cap} does not truly belong to me. It belongs to {contact.first}'s family.
entries.confirm: At last it is home. It always belonged with us.
